grievances.symptom: docs: use HTTPS for CrewAI AMP link in CLI concept doc
grievances.workaround: Fix: docs: use HTTPS for CrewAI AMP link in CLI concept doc. Target files: docs/edge/en/concepts/cli.mdx, docs/edge/ko/concepts/cli.mdx, docs/edge/pt-BR/concepts/cli.mdx. grievances.symptom: EncodingFlow.parallel_analyze crashes the whole save pipeline on transient storage listing failures
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix: guard storage listing failures in encoding flow analyze. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/memory/encoding_flow.py, lib/crewai/tests/memory/test_encoding_flow_analyze_fallback.py. `EncodingFlow.parallel_analyze()` calls `storage.list_scopes()` and `storage.list_categories()` unguarded. Both results only feed **suggestion lists** for the LLM field-resolution prompts, yet a transient storage read failure aborts the whole save pipeline: the listener raises, `memory.remember()` re-raises, and the memory is never persisted. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8568)

grievances.symptom: GuardrailResult result/error exclusivity validator is dead code for the success=True case
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix: enforce guardrail result/error exclusivity with model validator. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/utilities/guardrail.py, lib/crewai/tests/utilities/test_guardrail_result_exclusivity.py. `GuardrailResult.validate_result_error_exclusivity` is a `@field_validator("result", "error")`, but in pydantic v2 `info.data` only contains **previously validated** fields (declaration order: `success`, `result`, `error`). Validating `result` can never see `error`, so the `success=True` branch of the exclusivity rule is dead code: (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8570)

grievances.symptom: [BUG] docs: Incorrect CrewBase import in hook documentation examples
grievances.workaround: Fix: docs(hooks): fix CrewBase imports in examples. Import `CrewBase` from `crewai.project` in the kickoff and execution-hook examples. The documented `from crewai import CrewBase` raises `ImportError` with the current SDK. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8582)

grievances.symptom: [v2] docs:api fails on native Windows with backslash entry-point globs
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix(docs): use relative POSIX package entry globs. Target files: typedoc.config.mjs. On native Windows, `docs:api` receives absolute package entry points containing backslashes. TypeDoc treats these as glob escapes, finds none of the eight public packages, and exits with an error. Use package-relative POSIX globs so TypeDoc can resolve them and escape special characters in the checkout directory. Filesystem reads keep their native paths. (Ref: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/pull/3016)

grievances.symptom: `typing.Self` in a parametrized generic dataclass now fails schema generation
grievances.workaround: Fix: Fix `Self` resolution in parametrized generics. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py, tests/test_types_self.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/14064, regression in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13614. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/14065)

Added an `except HookAborted: raise` clause ahead of the generic handler, mirroring the existing `ToolExecu... (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8363)

grievances.symptom: Flow tool actions ignore tool_failure_policy: WARN/IGNORE tools kill the flow and no ToolFailureDetectedEvent is emitted
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix(flow): tool actions honor the tool's tool_failure_policy. grievances.symptom: Flow tool actions leak max_usage_count across kickoffs — the flow permanently fails after the budget is exhausted once
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix(flow): tool actions get a fresh usage budget per kickoff. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/flow/runtime/__init__.py, lib/crewai/src/crewai/flow/runtime/_actions.py, lib/crewai/tests/test_flow_tool_action_usage.py. Tool actions build their tool instances once per flow object (`_flow_post_init`) and reuse them across kickoffs, but nothing reset `current_usage_count` at the kickoff boundary. A `max_usage_count` budget exhausted in an earlier kickoff therefore made **every later kickoff of the same flow object fail**: `B... (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8424)

grievances.symptom: [BUG] Crew.test emits CrewTestFailedEvent with no CrewTestStartedEvent when create_llm fails — unpaired scope-ending event pops the caller's scope
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix: Crew.test emits its start event before setup so a failed setup pairs. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/crew.py, lib/crewai/tests/test_crew.py. `Crew.test` emits `CrewTestStartedEvent` before `create_llm` (`eval_llm` now carries the requested spec, which the field's `str | Any | None` type already allows) instead of after it, so a setup failure's `CrewTestFailedEvent` has its opener on the scope stack. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8420)

grievances.symptom: [BUG] Crew.replay() emits CrewKickoffStartedEvent but no CrewKickoffFailedEvent on failure — leaked kickoff scope corrupts later event lineage
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix: replay emits CrewKickoffFailedEvent when the replayed run fails. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/crew.py, lib/crewai/tests/test_crew.py. `Crew.replay`'s execution tail wraps `_execute_tasks` in try/except, emitting `CrewKickoffFailedEvent(started_event_id=self._kickoff_event_id)` before re-raising — mirroring `kickoff()`'s except-clause. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8418)

grievances.symptom: A guardrail that raises leaves LLMGuardrailStartedEvent without its completed event, so the trace span closes as orphaned
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix: emit LLMGuardrailCompletedEvent when a guardrail raises. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/utilities/guardrail.py, lib/crewai/tests/test_guardrail_events_on_exception.py. `process_guardrail` now emits `LLMGuardrailCompletedEvent(success=False, error="<Type>: <msg>")` and re-raises when the guardrail callable raises a non-`HookAborted` exception, mirroring the existing `HookAborted` branch (which keeps its exact legacy error string). (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8403)

grievances.symptom: [BUG] Hierarchical crew fails on its second kickoff: manager_llm crashes, manager_agent delegates to itself
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix(crew): let a hierarchical crew run more than once. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/crew.py, lib/crewai/tests/test_crew.py. A second `kickoff()`/`akickoff()`, `copy()` after a run, `kickoff_for_each()` after a run, and every `train(n_iterations > 1)` hit one of two problems: (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8369)

grievances.symptom: `wrangler auth token --json` prints nothing when `WRANGLER_LOG` is `warn`/`error`/`none`

grievances.symptom: v2: preserve forwarded notification params and support modern low-level serving
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix(server): preserve forwarded params and support modern low-level connections. A gateway cannot forward a change notification faithfully through `ServerEventBus`: the event carries only a kind/URI, so the listen router drops custom `_meta` and extension params. A manually connected `Server` also rejects a correctly classified modern request because advertis... (Ref: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/pull/3057)

grievances.symptom: FFMPEG_NULL_SINK_FALSE_PLAYABILITY: FFmpeg null-sink (-f null -) and single-frame extraction (-vframes 1) return exit code 0 on bit-corrupted MP4/H.264/HEVC files, causing agents to falsely declare unplayable, freezing, or truncated media as playable.
grievances.workaround: Enforce 3-point verification: (1) assert decoded duration >= 80% of container header duration; (2) extract visual frames at 25%, 50%, and 75% intervals with color entropy verification; (3) explicitly disclose discarded frame counts and truncated durations when using -fflags +discardcorrupt.

grievances.workaround: Fix: [deploy-helpers] Treat absent and undefined binding fields as equal in strict config diffs. The API omits `jurisdiction` in that case, but `mapWorkerMetadataBindings()` still sets an ow... (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16359)

grievances.symptom: PowerShell aliases 'curl' to Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.InvokeWebRequest. Running 'curl -X POST -H ... -d ...' throws positional parameter errors or strips quotes from JSON payload.
grievances.workaround: Always invoke 'curl.exe' explicitly or wrap commands in 'cmd /c "curl.exe ..."' with escaped quotes.

grievances.symptom: PowerShell 5.1 (default Windows 10/11) rejects '&&' syntax with 'ParserError: The token && is not a valid statement separator'. Agent enters retry loop trying bash chaining.
grievances.workaround: Use ';' sequence with '$?' check: '<cmd1>; if ($?) { <cmd2> }' or invoke via 'cmd /c "<cmd1> && <cmd2>"'.

grievances.symptom: Windows console defaults to cp1252. Python scripts printing Unicode, box-drawing characters, or emojis crash with 'UnicodeEncodeError: charmap codec can't encode character'.
grievances.workaround: Set environment variable PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 or write script outputs using open(..., encoding='utf-8').

grievances.symptom: Running 'wrangler whoami' or 'wrangler d1 execute --remote' without CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN attempts to open a local desktop browser and deadlocks headless agent stdin/stdout indefinitely.
grievances.workaround: Export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID into process environment before invoking wrangler, or inspect token presence before running remote commands.

grievances.symptom: gcloud commands prompt 'Do you want to continue (Y/n)?' in headless terminal subprocesses, freezing execution until watchdog timeout.
grievances.workaround: Always append '--quiet' flag to every gcloud CLI invocation (e.g. 'gcloud compute instances stop <name> --quiet').

grievances.symptom: npx <package> prompts 'Need to install the following packages: <pkg>. Ok to proceed? (y)' in headless subprocess, hanging the agent.
grievances.workaround: Always pass the '--yes' flag: 'npx --yes <package> <args>'.

grievances.symptom: Tailwind CSS v4 removes '@tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;'. Agents generated v3 CSS syntax resulting in un-styled raw HTML.
grievances.workaround: Replace CSS directives with '@import "tailwindcss";' and install '@tailwindcss/postcss' with postcss.config.mjs plugin '@tailwindcss/postcss': {}.

grievances.symptom: Next.js 15+ changed 'params' and 'searchParams' in page/layout/route handlers from synchronous objects to Promises. Sync access throws runtime Error: Route params should be awaited.
grievances.workaround: Update handler signature: 'export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) { const { id } = await params; }'.

grievances.symptom: Pydantic v2 removes model.dict() and class Config: orm_mode=True, raising PydanticUserError during model serialization.
grievances.workaround: Replace model.dict() with model.model_dump() and Config: orm_mode=True with model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True).

grievances.symptom: ESLint v9 deprecates .eslintrc.* legacy format. Running 'eslint .' fails with 'ESLint couldn't find an eslint.config.(js|mjs|cjs) file'.
grievances.workaround: Migrate to flat config 'eslint.config.mjs' exporting an array of configuration objects, or set ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false for legacy projects.

grievances.symptom: Cloudflare Pages Functions greedy catch-all router (functions/[[route]].js) intercepts GET requests for static CDN assets, returning 404 or 405.
grievances.workaround: In functions router, inspect request.method: if GET/HEAD, delegate immediately to 'env.ASSETS.fetch(request)'.

grievances.symptom: HTTP 204 No Content responses with 'Content-Type: application/json' header cause strict HTTP/MCP clients to fail parsing empty responses.
grievances.workaround: Separate CORS_ONLY headers (no Content-Type) for 204/202 from JSON_HEADERS (with Content-Type) used on 200 responses.

grievances.symptom: SQLite D1 does not allow ALTER TABLE to modify CHECK constraints. Adding an enum value causes SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_CHECK error on insert.
grievances.workaround: Perform standard SQLite table migration: CREATE TABLE new with updated CHECK constraint, copy rows, DROP old, and RENAME new to original.

grievances.symptom: FastMCP python sidecar on Windows can emit CRLF line endings on stdio transport, corrupting JSON-RPC framing in strict MCP clients.
grievances.workaround: Configure sys.stdout to binary write mode (sys.stdout.reconfigure(newline='\n')) or switch to remote Streamable HTTP transport.

grievances.symptom: Docker CLI invokes 'docker-credential-desktop.exe' on Windows when ~/.docker/config.json contains 'credsStore': 'desktop', throwing exit code 1 in background shells.
grievances.workaround: Remove 'credsStore' from ~/.docker/config.json or pass explicit auth tokens to daemon.

grievances.symptom: [BUG] Interrupted RWLock acquisition releases a lock it never acquired
grievances.workaround: Fix: fix(utilities): keep rwlock ownership when acquire is interrupted. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/utilities/rw_lock.py, lib/crewai/tests/utilities/events/test_rw_lock.py. `r_locked()` and `w_locked()` called acquire inside the `try` that always releases in `finally`. If `Condition.wait()` is interrupted before acquire finishes, the context manager releases a lock it never held. The reader count can drop below zero, and the writer flag can be cleared while another writer still owns the lock. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/7944)

grievances.workaround: Fix: Cancel legacy MCP initialization cleanly on close (#572). Target files: src/connectors/remote-mcp.ts, test/remote-mcp.test.ts. Closing a remote MCP connection during legacy initialization could leave an unhandled SDK rejection in workerd. Connection shutdown now aborts the in-flight handshake and skips its initialized notification only after that abort. Successful initialization and other notifications keep their existing behavior. (Ref: https://github.com/zackbart/connecta/pull/596)

Also disallowing negative values (this is a breaking change in theory but there's no reason for users to do this, and they easily use a positive value instead) so that we don't emit invalid `multipleOf` JSON Schema values (that are required to be `> 0`). (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13862)
